mentions.name: Chartrow
mentions.description: Chartrow is a web app for fast, dense stock market visualizations. It offers drawdown (from 52-week high) charts for top YTD performers in the NASDAQ 100, dense chart views of ETF holdings (e.g., ARKK), business fundamental trend charts (e.g., Microsoft), and multiple ways to view top-performing stocks, including charts, heatmap, and calendar views, switchable to tables. The author reports market data is purchased from twelvedata and continues tuning the app to feel responsive, like a native app.
